_readme: To swap in another clip: change footage.path, edit footage.speedMap / flightSrc / landingSrc / payoff.pageRect for its beat times, then run: node build/run.mjs (from the commercial folder).

footage._speedMap: Segments in source seconds, concatenated in order; each is retimed to outDuration (video: nearest-frame remap; audio: compressed segments keep their end-aligned part, 50 ms crossfades, no pitch shift). A segment with srcFrames plays exactly those source frame numbers (0-based, frame n = n/24 s); blend 'tmix3' averages the three source frames n-1,n,n+1 for motion blur, 'none' is a clean skip. Footage shorter than endCard is held on its last frame.

snapWhoosh._note: soft paper whoosh on the snap, cut from the native audio itself (tail of the lift whoosh), peak 4 dB under the native bed peak

events._note: Output-timeline seconds. landing is derived from footage.landingSrc; the quote card and scrim start cardAfterLanding later.

camera._note: Hook: opens on a 900x1600 window at (180,185) i.e. zoom 1.2 centred (630,985), eases out to the full frame by hook.dur. Push-in: 1.00 -> pushZoom from landing to endCard.

payoff._note: Touched page rectangle in 1080x1920 frame pixels (scrim hole and the point the quote card springs out of).

music._onsetAtNote: null = output time of footage.flightSrc through the speed map

voice._note: Cut points inside vo2.mp3 (seconds) and where each line is placed in the 10 s timeline.
